library.title: Library
library.empty: Import a folder or ZIP file with a Commander Keen game to get started.

runtime.title: Game engine
runtime.needed: BloogBase runs the games in DOSBox Staging, a free DOS emulator. It's downloaded once from its official website.
runtime.notInstalled: DOSBox Staging is not installed yet.
runtime.activeManaged: Using DOSBox Staging {{version}}, installed by BloogBase.
runtime.customHint: For advanced users. It has to be DOSBox Staging; other DOSBox versions can't keep your saves separate from the game files.
runtime.chooseInSettings: Choose an existing DOSBox Staging in the settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rerunHint: Download DOSBox and the free episodes, or add games from Steam and GOG.
settings.autoBackup: Back up saves before every game start
settings.keepBackups: Automatic backups to keep per game
settings.backupsHint: Backups you make yourself are never removed automatically. BloogBase also backs up before restoring or deleting a save.

displayHint.fullscreen: Press Alt+Enter at any time to switch between window and fullscreen.
displayHint.crt: Shows the games as on a monitor of the time, with scanlines and soft pixels. Turned off, pixels stay sharp.
displayHint.vsync: Helps if the picture tears horizontally while moving. Controls then react a tiny bit later; not needed on FreeSync or G-Sync monitors.
displayHint.all: Applies to all games from their next start. Single games can differ on their page under “DOSBox settings”.

settings.displayOverridden: Set by your DOSBox settings for all games (below).
settings.oneButtonFiringHint: Space shoots instead of Ctrl and Alt together, and Enter opens the status window. Mods that already work this way stay as they are; mods that change the controls differently are left alone. Shooting with a joystick may stop working. Applies from the next start.

errors.noGamesFound: No Commander Keen games were found there.
errors.unsupportedSource: Please choose a folder or a ZIP file.
errors.archive: The archive could not be read.
errors.network: The download didn't work. Please check your internet connection and try again.
errors.checksumMismatch: The downloaded file was damaged or changed, so it wasn't used. Please try again.
errors.unsupportedPlatform: There's no DOSBox Staging download for your system. You can choose an existing installation instead.
errors.runtimeMissing: DOSBox Staging is needed to play. Download it first.
errors.invalidRuntime: That doesn't look like DOSBox Staging ({{message}}).
errors.invalidLocation: BloogBase can't keep its data there ({{message}}).
errors.noModFound: No Commander Keen mod was found there.
errors.incompatibleInstall: The mod doesn’t fit that game ({{message}}).
errors.missingGame: This mod needs {{message}}. Add it to your library first.
errors.badSignature: The mod list couldn't be verified, so it wasn't used.
errors.notKeenWikiLink: Please paste a link to a mod page on keenwiki.shikadi.net, like https://keenwiki.shikadi.net/wiki/The_Alphamatic.
errors.notAModPage: That KeenWiki page doesn't describe a mod.
errors.deadLink: That download link doesn't work any more. Maybe the page lists another one, or the mod has moved.
errors.tooLarge: The download is far too big for a Commander Keen mod, so it was stopped.
errors.webPage: The link leads to a web page instead of a file. Open it in your browser, download the mod there and add it as a ZIP file or folder.
errors.unsupportedDownload: BloogBase can't open this download yet ({{message}}). Download it in your browser, unpack it and add the folder.
errors.noSavesFound: No saved games for this game were found in that file.
errors.otherGame: That backup belongs to another game ({{message}}).

setup.offline: You seem to be offline. Downloads need an internet connection; you can skip them and add games from your computer instead.

welcome.title: Welcome to BloogBase!
welcome.intro: BloogBase is a home for Commander Keen: your games and saves in one place, started with a single click.
welcome.steps: A few quick steps and you're ready to play. You can skip any of them and run the setup again from the settings.

storage.title: Where to keep your games
storage.intro: BloogBase keeps your games, saved games and DOSBox in this folder:
storage.usage: That needs about 150 MB. Most of it is DOSBox; each game only takes a few MB.
storage.locked: The folder can't be changed anymore because there are already games in it.
storage.restarting: BloogBase restarts to use the new folder…

engine.title: Game engine
engine.continue: You can continue while it downloads.

episodes.title: Free episodes
episodes.intro: Some episodes were also released as shareware. You can play them for free, even if you haven't bought Keen. Mods made for them work right away.
episodes.terms: BloogBase downloads the original, unmodified shareware releases from public archives (archive.org, textfiles.com). Shareware may be shared freely, but never sold.

owned.title: Already own Keen?
owned.intro: If you bought Commander Keen on Steam or GOG, BloogBase can add your games from there.
owned.scanning: Looking for games from Steam and GOG…
owned.noneFound: No Commander Keen games from Steam or GOG were found on this computer.
owned.other: Have the games somewhere else? Add them from a folder or ZIP file:
owned.buy: Where can I buy Commander Keen?

done.title: All set!
done.running: Downloads keep running in the background. Your games show up in the library as soon as they're ready.

mods.title: Try a mod
mods.intro: Fans have made many new adventures for Commander Keen. These work with your games:
mods.none: There are no suggestions for your games right now. Once you have a game, you'll find mods under Discover.
mods.later: You'll find many more under Discover.

drop.hint: Drop folders or ZIP files with games or mods to add them.
drop.title: Added to your library
drop.nothing: Neither a Commander Keen game nor a mod was found there.

mods.addHint: Or choose a mod you downloaded yourself: a ZIP file or an unpacked folder. BloogBase finds out which game it is for and how to start it.
mods.name: Name
mods.helpHint: This mod can be started in more than one way. If you are not sure, keep the first one; the mod’s readme may tell you more.

recipe.episode: Start the original game with the mod’s files

mods.missingGame: {{game}} isn’t in your library. Install the mod anyway? You can play it once the game is added.
mods.missingGame_version: {{game}} ({{versions}}) isn’t in your library. Install the mod anyway? You can play it once the game is added.
mods.versionUnchecked: BloogBase doesn’t know this version of the game, so it can’t check whether the mod fits. Give it a try!
mods.assumedVersion: This mod doesn’t say which version of the game it needs. Most mods for this episode are made for {{version}}, but yours is {{yours}}, so it may not work properly.
mods.modifiedGame: This copy of the game was changed (for example, its copy protection was removed). Mods that patch the game are usually made for the original and may not work with it.
mods.removeHint: The mod’s files are deleted. The game itself stays in your library.
mods.keepSaves_one: Keep the saved game as a backup
mods.keepSaves_other: Keep the {{count}} saved games as a backup
mods.waitingHint: Add {{game}} to your library to play this mod.

discover.title: Discover
discover.neverChecked: The mod list hasn't been loaded yet.
discover.hidden_one: Update BloogBase to see {{count}} more mod.
discover.hidden_other: Update BloogBase to see {{count}} more mods.
discover.offline: Showing the mod list from your last visit. {{message}}
discover.empty: The mod list couldn't be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
discover.withoutGameHint: {{game}} isn’t in your library. The mod is installed now and can be played once you add the game.

keenwiki.label: KeenWiki link
keenwiki.inIndex: This mod is in the BloogBase mod list, tested and ready to install:
keenwiki.noDownload: This page has no download link. Download the mod in your browser and add it as a ZIP file or folder.
keenwiki.otherGame: The KeenWiki page says this mod is for {{page}}, but its files look like {{files}}.
keenwiki.suggest: Suggest it for the mod list

profile.notFound: This game isn’t in the library any more.

firing.on: Space shoots, Enter opens the status window.
firing.builtIn: This mod already shoots with Space.
firing.unavailable: One-button firing isn’t available here: this game or mod changes the controls differently.

profile.removeGameHint: BloogBase deletes its copy of the game. The folder or archive you added it from stays untouched.
profile.removeGameMods_one: Also uninstall the mod played on it
profile.removeGameMods_other: Also uninstall the {{count}} mods played on it
profile.removeGameModsKept: Otherwise they move to another copy of the game, or wait until it’s back.

saves.title: Saved games
saves.empty: No saved games yet. Save in the game and they show up here.
saves.locked: The game is running. Close it to change saves or restore a backup.
saves.unreadable: Couldn’t read the details of this save.
saves.deleteHint: It’s backed up first, so you can get it back from the backups below.
saves.deleted: Save deleted. A backup was kept.

backups.title: Backups
backups.label: Label for the backup
backups.imported: Backup imported. Restore it to use the saves.
backups.restored: Restored. What was there before was backed up.
backups.restoreAllHint: Puts all files of this backup back. Other saves stay.
backups.restoreAllReplaces_one: Restoring everything replaces {{count}} current save; it’s backed up first.
backups.restoreAllReplaces_other: Restoring everything replaces {{count}} current saves; they’re backed up first.
backups.otherFiles_one: One other file (settings or high scores) is restored too.
backups.otherFiles_other: {{count}} other files (settings, high scores) are restored too.
backups.deleteHint: “{{name}}” from {{date}} will be gone for good.

config.globalHint: DOSBox Staging settings that apply to every game. Each game can override them on its page.
config.profileHint: Only for this game; they win over BloogBase’s defaults and your settings for all games.
config.effectiveHint: All layers together. The last one that sets a value wins.
config.saved: Saved. Takes effect on the next start.
config.resetHint: Your changes here are removed and BloogBase’s defaults apply again.

warning.autoexec: [autoexec] is ignored, BloogBase starts the game itself

screenshots.hint: Press {{key}} while playing to take a screenshot.
screenshots.empty: Press {{key}} while playing to keep a moment. Your screenshots show up here.

videos.hint: Press {{key}} while playing to start or stop recording.
videos.empty: Press {{key}} while playing to start recording and again to stop. Your videos show up here.
videos.player: Videos play in your video player. DOSBox records them in its own format (ZMBV), which VLC can play, for example.

about.title: About BloogBase
about.tagline: A cozy home for Commander Keen: play the games and the community's mods with a single click.
about.author: Made by <profile>{{name}}</profile>
about.authorProfile: Open profile on the PCKF forum
about.trademark: Commander Keen is a trademark of id Software. BloogBase is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, ZeniMax Media, Apogee or Softdisk. All other names and trademarks belong to their owners.
about.noGameData: BloogBase contains no game data. The free shareware episodes are downloaded unchanged from public archives; everything else comes from your own copies. Mods are downloaded from their authors' original sources.
about.thanksText: To the Keen community, whose mods, research and documentation make all of this possible, and to the mod authors credited on every mod's page.
about.license: BloogBase is free software under the MIT license.
about.dosbox: Games run in DOSBox Staging {{version}}, which BloogBase downloads from its official releases and starts as a separate program. DOSBox Staging is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later; its source code is available from the DOSBox Staging project.
about.fonts: Fonts: Inter and Press Start 2P, both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Icons: Lucide (ISC license).
about.licensesMissing: The license list is created for release builds. Run pnpm licenses:generate to create it.

updates.title: Updates
updates.whilePlaying: Close the running game first; BloogBase restarts to finish the update.

quit.body_one: {{games}} is still running. If you close BloogBase now, its play time can’t be tracked properly.
quit.body_other: {{games}} are still running. If you close BloogBase now, their play time can’t be tracked properly.
quit.stopHint: Progress you haven’t saved in the game is lost.
quit.keepHint_one: The game keeps running; only the time played so far counts.
quit.keepHint_other: The games keep running; only the time played so far counts.
